title: Mobility aid quick repair triage
summary: A quick triage for canes, walkers, wheelchairs, crutches, brakes, tips, straps, and seats after evacuation, stairs, rubble, rain, or transport damage.
content: Core sequence: 1) Ask the user what feels unsafe before touching the aid or changing its setup. 2) Check brakes, tips, wheels, loose bolts, torn straps, sharp edges, and wet surfaces in that order. 3) Make only reversible temporary fixes and mark them visibly as temporary. 4) Do a short test on flat ground before using ramps, stairs, crowds, or uneven paths.
